quote.text: My finances are scattered across too many apps

promise.text: Organize your finances from scratch, one gap at a time

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "app", "apps"

lines.text: Make a provisional money map, mark what you do not know, and verify the next obligations before treating a balance as money you can spend.

head.text: Build a dated bill list and identify the paying accounts.
Review the statement and investigate unfamiliar charges through official channels.
Collect balances, rates, required payments and special terms before comparing strategies.
Move from the map to a budget and a short repeating review.

eyebrow.text: Make the first pass small enough to finish

items.text: Write the six headings in one place you can reopen.
List the accounts and providers you remember without trying to make the page look complete.
Label remembered figures as estimates and date the page.
Circle any possible payment, notice or safety issue that cannot wait.
Choose one gap with an immediate consequence, such as the next bill date.
Verify it using a current statement or the provider's official account page.

line.text: One place holding accounts, income, bills, subscriptions, transactions, debt and savings, with a single figure for what is actually available.
